name: DwarfStar
notes: Inference engine by antirez for DeepSeek V4.x GGUF; server binary is ds4-server. The Strix Halo numbers in this repo were measured by Donato Capitella (kyuz0) from container docker.io/kyuz0/strix-halo-ds4-toolbox:rocm-10.0, so the ROCm build is a fork image rather than the upstream Metal tree. Engine versions recorded per benchmark are image content hashes, not git tags.
